stratagem.name: FOR THE EMPEROR!
stratagem.lore: Unflinching in their loyalty to Chapter and Primarch, battle-brothers seize and hold their objectives with unrelenting determination and zealous fury.
stratagem.target: One friendly TACTICUS unit that is within range of an objective.
stratagem.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagem.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagem.lore: Pressing mercilessly forward, these warriors place shots and blows perfectly, no matter their targets.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.
stratagem.effect: Your unit’s attacks have: ▪ [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]. ▪ Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

stratagem.name: POINT-BLANK BRUTALITY
stratagem.lore: Transhuman skill and reaction times render these Space Marines’ firearms as deadly up close as any blade.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged TACTICUS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagem.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Blast] attacks) have: ▪ [Close-Quarters]. ▪ [Ignores Cover].
